home.methodTitle: Three things you can check us on
home.method1Title: We have walked every unit here
home.method1Body: Nothing goes on this site from a photo someone sent us. If a listing is live, one of us has been inside it and measured what is written on the plan.
home.method2Title: Every listing says what it still needs
home.method2Body: Floor, finish, what is missing and roughly what it costs to fix. A semi-finished 165 m² on Haram Street needs about 450,000 to complete, and the listing says so.
home.method3Title: We leave sold units up, with their price
home.method3Body: You cannot judge an asking price without seeing what things actually close at. Sold units stay on the site, marked sold, with the figure they went for.

home.planBody: Scroll and the plan draws itself — walls, then dimensions, then each room with its area measured off the drawing. Buyers spend longer here than anywhere else on a listing, so it is the thing we build best.
home.closeBody: Every unit on this site has a code like ALS-0412. Send it on WhatsApp and you will get the floor, the papers and a viewing time — not a brochure.

services.title: Services
services.metaTitle: Buying, selling and new-law leasing in Giza
services.metaDescription: What Alaser does for buyers, sellers and landlords across Faisal, Haram, Hadayek El-Ahram, 6 October and Sheikh Zayed.
services.intro: Four things, and we will tell you when one of them is not what you need.
services.buyBody: You tell us the budget and the area. We shortlist from what we have walked, take you round, and check the papers before you pay a deposit. On the Hadayek grid that last part is the whole job.
services.sellBody: We price against what actually closed nearby, not against what neighbours are asking. Photographs, a measured plan and the listing written properly in both languages. You approve the price before it goes up.
services.rentBody: Fixed-term leases under the new rent law, for both sides. We draft the increase clause so it is written rather than argued about later, and we check the tenant.
services.commercialBody: Frontage, footfall, power supply and whether a licence transfers. Different questions from a flat, and the ones that decide whether a pitch works.

about.title: About
about.metaDescription: A Giza brokerage working Faisal, Haram, Hadayek El-Ahram, 6th of October and Sheikh Zayed.
about.intro: Alaser is a real estate marketing company based in Faisal, Giza.
about.body: We work five areas — Faisal, Haram, Hadayek El-Ahram, 6th of October and Sheikh Zayed — in sale and in new-law rent, across apartments, villas, shops and cafés. The office is on Kaabish in El-Tawabeq, which is where most of the units we handle are within a short drive of.
about.statsEmpty: We will publish our numbers once they are audited rather than estimated.

portfolio.title: Every unit, as a sheet in a bound set.
portfolio.lead: Every unit we have listed right now, set as a printed spread — the photograph on one page, the measured sheet on the other. Turn it the way you would the one on our desk in Faisal.
portfolio.howTo: Open the cover, then pick up a page and turn it — or use the arrows and the keyboard.

portfolio.coverSub: Units for sale and new-law rent
portfolio.colophonBody: Each unit takes two pages. The photograph comes first; the sheet facing it carries what we measured. The title block in the corner of every sheet is the same four facts, always in the same place:
portfolio.keyRef: The reference code. Send it on WhatsApp and we know which unit you mean.
portfolio.keyFloor: The floor, and how many the building has.
portfolio.keyFacing: Which way the main facade faces. North-facing is the one people ask for.
portfolio.plateCaption: Giza — the five areas this volume covers.
portfolio.enquireBody: Send the reference code from the corner of any sheet. You will get the floor, the papers and a viewing time — not another brochure.
portfolio.backNote: Prices and availability change. This volume was set on {date}.
portfolio.requestCopyNote: We send it on WhatsApp, so you can forward it to whoever is deciding with you.
